fluff.overview: The Achileus is a light battle armor suit developed jointly by the Free Worlds League and the Word of Blake. Designed as a mass-produced alternative to custom-manufacture stealth suits, the Achileus combined offensive armament with electronic stealth capability in a package suitable for large-scale deployment. Entering service in 3057, the suit filled a critical gap in both the FWLM and Word of Blake Militia force structures, providing infantry formations with a jump-capable scout platform that could evade electronic detection. Production was handled by facilities on Irian and Gibson within the Free Worlds League.
fluff.capabilities: This configuration replaces the standard modular weapon mount with a David light Gauss rifle, giving the Achileus a significant ranged punch. The light Gauss rifle fires magnetically accelerated projectiles at velocities sufficient to threaten light vehicles and other battle armor, marking a substantial upgrade in lethality over the suit's original weapon options. The left-arm anti-personnel weapon mount and basic manipulators on both arms remain standard. Jump jets provide 90-meter mobility, and 360 kilograms of improved stealth armor maintains the suit's sensor-evasion capability. The David configuration pushed the Achileus beyond pure scouting into a light striker role, though ammunition constraints require careful shot discipline during extended patrols.
fluff.deployment: Four-trooper squads armed with the David light Gauss rifle gave FWLM commanders a battle armor formation with genuine anti-armor capability. These squads were assigned to frontline units where they could engage enemy battle armor and light vehicles at range, a significant upgrade from the purely anti-personnel configurations that preceded them.
fluff.history:
Development of the Achileus began in October 3054 as a collaborative effort between Free Worlds League and Word of Blake research teams. The project used the Blakist Tornado PA(L) suit as its foundation, seeking to transform the specialized sneak suit into a more capable combat platform. Early prototypes produced in May 3055 struggled to balance armor protection, weaponry, and stealth performance. A breakthrough came when Word of Blake ROM allegedly acquired proprietary armor composite data from Defiance Industries and the New Avalon Institute of Science, enabling the team to meet FWLM protection standards without sacrificing stealth capability.

Production began at Irian BattleMechs Unlimited on Irian, with Free Worlds Defence Industries on Gibson later establishing a second line dedicated to Word of Blake variants. Defiance Industries protested the apparent theft of intellectual property before the Second Star League's Economic Council, but the FedCom Civil War and the League's eventual collapse left the matter unresolved. Both the FWLM and Word of Blake Militia fielded the Achileus extensively during the Jihad. The suit also saw adoption by other Inner Sphere powers in later decades as production continued at Irian facilities under new ownership, and a third manufacturing line on Washburn further expanded availability.
